elements.content: My birthday was on Sunday. My parents held a birthday party at home for me. I invited some friends to come to the party. At the party, they gave me many nice presents, such as cards, picture books and pens. They sang “Happy Birthday” to me. My mother made a big cake for me. My father bought a lot of snacks. I cut the cake into small pieces and shared them with my friends. Then we sang and danced together. We had a good time at my birthday party.

elements.content:

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

child_list.content: 我的生日
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 我的生日在星期天。我的父母在家里为我举行了一个生日聚会。我邀请了一些朋友来参加聚会。在聚会上，他们送给我许多漂亮的礼物，比如贺卡、图画书和笔。他们给我唱《生日快乐》歌。我妈妈给我做了一个大蛋糕。我爸爸买了很多零食。我把蛋糕切成小块，和我的朋友们分享。然后我们一起唱歌跳舞。我们在生日聚会上玩得很开心。
child_list.name: 文本框

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
